events.summary: sword-interaction-attempt.v1 {"action":"request","actor_id":"char_tang_wei","formation_refs":[],"player_statement":"Father, Mother: I want House Tang to establish a permanent Great Bow Guard, separate from the existing 100 Tang Champions. Its fighting establishment is 300, but no slot is to be filled below standard. Recruit broadly and competitively, subsidize access without lowering standards, and select men who can fight as heavy great-war-bow infantry, shielded phalanx, spear line, and swordsmen. Equip them in proprietary Tang armor and helmets with Great War Bow, shield, long spear, long one-hand sword, and 36 carried war arrows each. Train repeated conversion between Bow Order, Phalanx, Shielded Order, and Sword Order; select officers from demonstrated rotating command; finish with a weeks-long field camp. The first 300 who truly qualify become the founders. Plan forge capacity, materials, replacement stocks, support staff outside the 300 fighting slots, and at least 54,000 war arrows for initial field establishment, with training ammunition separate. Exercise them with the Tang Champions but keep the units distinct. I want the real cost, a treasury-safe spend, recruitment and support requirements, forge bottlenecks, operating cost, and normal, accelerated, and fastest sustainable schedules. Three hundred is the establishment. Excellence is the requirement.
